Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures

rows: Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
Make sure the siren works.
Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Dry chemical powder fire-fighting system
Make sure the powder tank body has no corrosion or holes, and carry out the necessary maintenance (scraping, repainting) when needed.
Replace the expired powder with a valid one for five years, and make sure the powder tank is filled with the ideal quantity.
Make sure the refill opening is tightly closed to maintain the ideal operating pressure.
Record the refill date and shelf life on a sticker and place it in a visible place on the powder tank body.
Carry out the body test on the two nitrogen cylinders, refill them to the ideal pressure, seal them, and place them in their designated place.

Make sure the powder accessories are in working order:
 valves, hoses, manometers
.

Third: 
 Fire truck accessories
Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the 5-yearly inspection of the powder fire-fighting system used in fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Osama Ismail El-Mashad, tested by Eng. El-Sayed Ahmed El-Desouky, and reviewed by Eng. Mostafa El-Nady Abdel Rahman.
And approved by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali, Head of Talkha Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
2 m long powder stirring rod
Multi-purpose dry chemical powder sufficient to fill the powder tank
Vehicle tool bag
Cleaning tools
2 m long powder stirring rod
Multi-purpose dry chemical powder sufficient to fill the powder tank
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures
1. | Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
2. | Make sure the siren works.
3. | Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Dry chemical powder fire-fighting system
1. | Make sure the powder tank body has no corrosion or holes, and carry out the necessary maintenance (scraping, repainting) when needed.
2. | Replace the expired powder with a valid one for five years, and make sure the powder tank is filled with the ideal quantity.
3. | Make sure the refill opening is tightly closed to maintain the ideal operating pressure.
4. | Record the refill date and shelf life on a sticker and place it in a visible place on the powder tank body.
5. | Carry out the body test on the two nitrogen cylinders, refill them to the ideal pressure, seal them, and place them in their designated place.
6. | Make sure the powder accessories are in working order:
 valves, hoses, manometers
.
Third: 
 Fire truck accessories
1. | Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
2. | Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
3. | Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
4. | Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.
